chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 05 (Unit 14: Current Electricity)
subject: physics-10

questions.question: Batteries are rated in 'Ampere-hours' (Ah). Ampere-hour is a commercial unit of:
questions.explanation: Current × Time = (Coulombs/second) × seconds = Coulombs (electric charge). 1 Ah = 3600 C.

questions.question: When connected to a battery, a filament bulb glows brightly. If battery polarity is reversed, the bulb will glow:
questions.explanation: A tungsten filament bulb produces heat via Joule heating (P = I²R), which is independent of current direction.

questions.question: Electric current that periodically reverses its direction and magnitude over regular intervals of time is known as:
questions.explanation: AC reverses polarity cyclically (50 Hz in Pakistan) unlike steady DC from chemical batteries.

Electricity main supply meters measure consumer electrical consumption in units of kilowatt-hours (kWh). Kilowatt-hour is a unit of:
questions.explanation: Power × Time = Energy. 1 kWh = 1000 W × 3600 s = 3.6 × 10⁶ Joules (3.6 MJ).

questions.question: One thousand joules (1000 J) of electrical energy is equivalent to approximately:
Which of the following circuit components demonstrates purely Ohmic behavior (constant resistance)?

options.C: Fixed metallic resistor at constant temperature

questions.explanation: Ohm's law holds for metallic conductors maintained at constant temperature, producing a linear V-I graph.

questions.question: An ideal voltmeter should possess an internal resistance that is:
questions.explanation: An ideal voltmeter is connected in parallel and must draw zero current to avoid altering circuit conditions, requiring infinite internal resistance.

questions.question: The electromotive force (EMF) unit Volt is mathematically equivalent to:
questions.explanation: EMF = Energy supplied / Charge = E/Q, measured in Joules per Coulomb (J C⁻¹).

questions.question: In domestic electrical wiring, a fuse or circuit breaker is always connected in series with the:
questions.explanation: Connecting the fuse in the live wire ensures that when it blows during an overload, the high-voltage potential is disconnected from the appliance.

questions.question: Human skin in dry conditions exhibits an electrical resistance of approximately:
questions.explanation: Dry human skin has a high resistance around 100,000 Ω (10⁵ Ω), which drops dramatically to around 1,000 Ω when wet.
